issue: Four bounded Pump differential runners read the captured Pump image, the shared Mayhem/Pump Fees images, the captured config snapshot, the signed v3 curve transaction and the dependency ELFs, then truncated --output with write_text/write_bytes. Passing an input as --output destroyed captured evidence, or replaced the executing runner with its own report.
affected: scripts/pump_create_control_differential.py, scripts/pump_set_creator_differential.py, scripts/pump_v3_configured_fee_differential.py, scripts/pump_v3_token_extensions_differential.py at base; each writer is the last statement of its main block
finding: Base run of the new test: 18 failing subtests in 6 tests. --output on the captured image overwrote it, and --output on the runner itself replaced the module with the report so the same run could no longer import it. Sibling runners (pump create/extend, Pump state/migration, Mayhem validators, the AMM family) already admit their destination.

change.publisher: PumpReport(output, ROOT, candidate, __file__, extra_inputs=[...]) built immediately after parse_args and before either image is pinned or a case executes
change.report_inputs: the create-control runner declares the Mayhem image and the token_metadata dependency ELF; the v3 pair declares pump_trade_fixture.REPORT_INPUTS (the signed v3 curve fixture plus the pump/pump_fees/dependency captures and ELFs); the creator-setter runner reads only inputs PumpReport already protects
change.write: publisher.write(payload) with the existing payload construction, gzip mtime pinning and suffix-conditional compression retained
change.failure: ValueError: report output aliases an input: <path>, exit 1, before a case runs and before any output directory is created

runs.case_payload_unchanged: base and proposed receipts are identical once embedded source hashes are ignored (script_sha256, provenance, harness_sha256): create_control 85 cases, set_creator 509, v3_configured_fee 372, v3_token_extensions 126, all with no mismatches
runs.alias_refusals: 18 refusals exercised by the new test (captured image, captured config snapshot, candidate, executing script; the saved v3 transaction for the pair); each exits non-zero with the alias message and leaves the target bytes unchanged
runs.publication_control: each runner publishes a fresh nested receipt: mismatch-free JSON, non-empty cases, and no staging file left beside it

tests.before: 18 failing subtests in 6 tests against the base scripts (84.1s)

unchanged: captured images, dependency ELFs, config snapshot and signed v3 transaction
report schema, gzip mtime pinning and compact separators
receipt bytes apart from embedded source hashes
not_claimed: The controls prove admission and publication on synthetic local fixtures; they do not re-run the full v3 corpora against every candidate class and make no byte-identity claim about the rebuilt program.
